claims.text: A symmetric proposal moves from a state of target weight 3 to weight 1. Under the Metropolis rule, what is acceptance probability? Options: 1/3; 1/2; 1. Toy model: compare two controlled cases.

claims.text: For symmetric proposals, acceptance is min(1, new target weight / old target weight). Downhill proposals can be accepted. That permission helps the chain explore; it is not a rule to keep only improving states.
